# Understand App Capabilities

Hi, welcome to SeaTalk Open Platform! We provides versatile app capabilities for you to build apps based on your own needs. Currently, three app capabilities are supported:

1. Bot
2. Workspace App
3. Login With SeaTalk

# App Capabilities Comparison

Wondering which app capability should you select for your app? See the table below for a comparison of the three capabilities:

|App Capability||Primary User Touchpoint|Clients Supported|User Experience|Most Suitable When...|
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
|Bot||Chatroom|Mobile, PC|Similar to chatting with normal user|- The app logic involves many conversations that are currently handled by human agents|
|Workspace App|Web|Workspace|Mobile, PC|Similar to visiting a website in a web browser|- There is an existing web app that needs a quick integration with SeaTalk - The targeted app users mainly use PC devices for their day-to-day work|
||RN (React Native)|Workspace|Mobile|Close to the native experience|- You want your users to enjoy an experience nearly identical to the native one|
|Login with SeaTalk||Third-party web page|PC|Allow users to log in using their SeaTalk account|You want your users to log in with their SeaTalk account info|

However, if your app does not need any front-end user interface and involves purely back-end logic (such as auditing apps), you can always release your apps without any of these capabilities. You can just create an app with whichever capability and use the server APIs provided in the Scopes & Permissions section.

# App Capabilities Compatibility

There are cases when several app capabilities are required under one app. For example:

* Web is used on the PC clients, while RN is used on the mobile clients
* An RN app contains a lot of UIUX to fulfil complex business logic, while a bot addresses FAQs in 1-on-1 chats

To make app development more powerful, SeaTalk Open Platform provides a flexible app architecture that makes all the app capabilities compatible with each other. You may easily enable or disable capabilties from your app's profile page ([open.seatalk.io](open.seatalk.io) > My Apps > click on any app). A single app may have any number of capabilites, allowing you to customize it to yours and your users' exact needs.
